_comment: State file for the product-digest skill (The Digest — Product Edition, monthly). Read at the start of every run; written ONLY on publish — test runs never pollute trend_history. Updated on the Issue 3 publish (2026-08-03).

trend_history.this_month_development: Same-day 10 Jun double-header: Visa Agent Score / Agentic Directory / LTM + Visa-OpenAI partnership; Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines (30+ partners, multi-rail). Zero mentions of offers/rewards across the three releases.

trend_history.trend: Pay by Bank / A2A goes operational
trend_history.this_month_development: UKPI commercial VRP scheme live 2 Jun (first new UK scheme since 2008, 31 firms; Wave 2 e-commerce H2 2026); GoCardless Recurring Pay by Bank on day one; TrueLayer Bank on File carried the scheme's first live payments (3 Jun).

trend_history.trend: OS wallet as the loyalty surface
trend_history.this_month_development: iOS 27 Wallet (WWDC, 10 Jun): camera-scan any loyalty card, Tap to Share loyalty identity in-store; ships ~Sept. Supporting: Visa Flexible Credential UK on Zilch (12 May, near-window, disclosed).

Lloyds Rewards in-app hub launched across Lloyds/Halifax/BoS (first £2,026 prize draw 1 Jun, deposit-gated; merchant offers + personalised cashback — first-party build); Chase UK 2% cashback behaviour-conditional from 1 Jun (15 transactions/DDs + £1,000 in savings); Nationwide £100 Fairer Share confirmed 21 May (£440m to 4.4m members).

dunnhumby network alliance (19 Jun — single cross-retailer route, Tesco/B&Q/John Lewis/Waitrose pilots, Kevel, shared measurement standards); SMG RMX, the UK's first retail media exchange (Jun); Asda x Amazon Retail Ad Service (23 Jun — first retailer outside the US to license Amazon's ad stack, rollout Q4 2026); Nectar360 first UK network IAB Europe-certified (1 Jul) + Pollen platform (Unilever, Coca-Cola). UK retail media spend forecast £4.8bn in 2026.

trend_history.trend: Agent checkout opens to every merchant (agentic commerce)
trend_history.this_month_development: Shopify Spring '26 (17 Jun) removed the approval gate: any developer registers an agent profile + calls the public MCP endpoint; UCP (co-developed with Google) covers discovery→checkout; trust tiers unlock direct checkout. No loyalty/offers/rewards as first-class objects; Talon.One UIP unmoved since Jan 2026. Evolution of Issue 1's networks trust-layer thread — platform-side this time.

trend_history.trend: Gulf banks build the rewards hub in-house
trend_history.this_month_development: Emirates NBD Rewards Hub on ENBD X (10 Jun — unified in-app lifestyle/rewards marketplace, built with Vernost; 15% launch offers, AED 10k weekly draw, pay by card/points/part/instalments); Mashreq 'Everyday Cashback' (22 Jun — automated Visa card-linked cashback up to 20%, debit & credit first time, powered by vendor Rezolve Ai, in-app/personalised). Build vs buy, both live in the GCC sales region.

trend_history.trend: Reward value re-priced away from cashback
trend_history.this_month_development: Barclays summer switch (9 Jun) makes the headline Premier reward a £600 experience vs £200 cash; ING Spain (10 Jun) packages rewards into four paid subscription tiers (Revolut/N26 playbook); PayPal Rewards (US, ~29 Jun) ends cash-out from 1 Aug, forces points into closed-loop redemption. Three axes: experiences, membership, closed-loop points.

trend_history.trend: The offer follows the wallet (distribution leaves the bank app)
trend_history.this_month_development: Rezolve Ai embedded Reward's engagement/commerce-media platform into Zilch (21 Jul — ~6m customers, $3.3bn/yr merchant flow, hundreds of UK retailers; Reward in 15+ markets, $2bn cashback returned); Mastercard Wallet Services (15 Jul — SDKs/Secure Element applet/MDES tokenisation let any bank, fintech or merchant hold contactless in its own app, 200+ countries, iOS first US/UK/Europe, Fourez naming 'benefits, rewards, discounts, points' as the hook); Riyadh Air RX Pay (late Jul, Saudi Arabia — airline owns the Sfeer Points currency, Saudi banks issue, points redeemable on any Mastercard purchase globally).

trend_history.trend: The agent rails go live at the banks (agentic commerce)
trend_history.this_month_development: Visa completed live agent-driven purchases in Europe with 30+ banks incl. Barclays, HSBC UK, Lloyds, Nationwide, NatWest, Revolut, Klarna (3 Jul; merchants lastminute.com/Frasers/Cleverbridge/BrickDepot; Payment Passkeys + Trusted Agent Protocol + Agent Directory) with no offer/reward/loyalty object named. UCP technical council put saved payment methods on identity-linking infrastructure rather than a separate extension, making identity the transactability layer; identity live at 15 stores, 3 more vendors declaring identity extensions, 99.7% on one spec revision, 0 of 11,414 verified stores exposing payment (UCP Checker, July). No loyalty-programme integrations or dedicated discount protocols announced in the period (agenticplug). Third-issue evolution: the gap moved from 'no loyalty object' to 'the object rides on identity linking and is barely switched on'.

trend_history.trend: Everyone is selling the engagement layer
trend_history.this_month_development: Visa Q3 call 28 Jul (reported 30 Jul): value-added services +34% to $3.8bn, near a third of revenue, positioned as a loyalty and engagement engine — Brazilian bank World Cup promo (1m participants, 8% activation lift, $400m incremental volume), Mexican co-brand 5x average transaction size on match days, Visa Direct behind DoorDash Crimson, white-label AI financial assistant for issuer apps. Dotdigital launched a native loyalty product (16 Jul) on Customer Trends Index research (4,000 consumers UK/US/AU/SG: 62% points, 53% free shipping, 52% cashback, 45% raised spend for a tier, only 15% find marketing 'very relevant'). Eagle Eye x Central Retail Vietnam past 5.8m members within months (27 Jul).

roadmap_threads_history.thread: A2A coverage gap — recurring payments under UKPI produce no card transaction for card-linked offers to read
Loyalty absent from the agent rails — agentic trust layer specified with no offers/rewards object
Retail media gets an audited yardstick — IAB Europe Retail Media Certification live in the UK (Nectar360 first, 1 Jul, ABC-audited) + dunnhumby alliance built on shared measurement standards

The opening agent rails still have no loyalty object — Shopify opened MCP/UCP to every developer (17 Jun) with no offers/points/rewards as first-class objects; Talon.One UIP unmoved since January (platform-side evolution of the Issue 1 agent-rails gap)

The card-linked stack has left the bank app — Reward's engagement/commerce-media platform live inside Zilch's payments journey (21 Jul, ~6m customers) and Mastercard Wallet Services (15 Jul) making the contactless credential something any app can hold, with the network naming rewards, discounts and points as the reason to build one

On the agent rails the loyalty hook is identity, and it is barely switched on — 30+ European banks live with agent purchases naming no offer object (3 Jul), while identity linking (the capability carrying member/loyalty benefits) was made foundational to transactability in July yet runs at 15 stores against 11,414 verified, none payment-capable (third-issue evolution of the Issue 1 and Issue 2 agent-rails threads)

source_map._comment: v1.2 self-correcting source map. unlisted_entities: candidate-pool companies not on the spec's named competitor list; two appearances promotes them into the spec on publish. last_reviewed_issue triggers the six-issue named-list review (next due at Issue 7). Issue 3 promoted Rezolve Ai (seen Issues 2 and 3) into the spec's named competitor list. Shopify and Talon.One appeared in Issue 3 only as dated background citations, not as in-window findings, so their seen_issues were deliberately not incremented — recurrence should be evidenced by findings, not citations.
